notes: Canonical composition: app/client/src/features/settings-panel/DomainAccordionRow.tsx used by SettingsPanel DomainsSection.
Settings-owned Controllers-style disclosure; not a product-neutral src/ui Accordion primitive.
Locked-fact expand body only — no storageSummary / ProgressBar-on-expand.
Synthetic labels only; no credentials, private IDs, runtime URLs, or server payloads.

geometry.layout: single-row header with leading chevron, name/id stack, status, lifecycle slot; expand region below
geometry.density: compact row padding px-3.5 py-2.5; expand body px-3.5 py-3

expectedTokenGeometry: Expand body uses --ui-bg tint without ProgressBar chrome
Collapsed and expanded variants share header density

r10.keyboardTouch: expand/collapse IconButton is keyboard-focusable and activatable
r10.focus: chevron control receives focus; expand region is a labeled region when open
r10.screenReader: aria-expanded and aria-controls wire the disclosure; state StatusPill text is present
r10.reducedMotion: chevron rotation uses motion-reduce:transition-none; no motion-dependent correctness
r10.validationBusyDisabledStatus: lifecycle slot can host ToggleSwitch; status hosts StatusPill
r10.zoom: display name remains present at component level
r10.darkLight: render under data-theme zai-dark and zai-light wrappers
r10.narrow: header flex wraps via parent Settings density; claimed via shared viewport labels
